activation.title: Activate PROSM Time
activation.subtitle: Enter your activation code to set up your organization.
activation.logoHint: Optional — it will appear next to your organization's data in the Header, and on your license certificate. You can also add this later.
activation.emailPolicyNotice: The email address you use to create this organization is the only email PROSM Time will recognize for it. All technical support for this organization is provided through that email address only.

certificate.title: License Activation Certificate
certificate.footer: This certificate confirms activation of PROSM Time for the organization above.

activation.demoTitle: Try PROSM Time free for 30 days
activation.demoSubtitle: Create your organisation and its manager now, without an activation code. The trial lasts 30 days, and your data stays saved afterwards.
activation.demoNotice: Demo version: no activation code needed. The trial ends 30 days after it starts (server time). A week before, the owner is emailed; after it ends the organisation becomes read-only, with all its data kept, until an activation code is entered or the license is renewed.
activation.ownerLegalNameHint: As written on your ID - it is recorded in the licence.
activation.legalNameError: Enter your full official name (at least 3 names).
activation.nationalIdError: Enter a valid national ID number.

starter.name: Starter
starter.description: Clocking at the site with GPS, geofence, photo proof, offline and the map; basic reports; owner and employees.

business.name: Business
business.description: Everything in Starter, unlimited sites, leave, allowances and approvals, kiosk, clocking on behalf, shift scheduling, report and payroll export, manager roles.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: Everything in Business, audit log, SOS, all roles and permissions, labour cost and budgets, daily summary and manager alerts, 5 years of records.

welcome.title: Welcome to PROSM Time
welcome.subtitle: Workforce attendance, presence and time management.
welcome.webNote: To manage your organisation (sites, reports and settings), we recommend the web version on a computer: it works much better than on a phone.
welcome.salesBody: For the paid plan, please contact the PROSM sales team at: {{email}}

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your PROSM Time organization.
login.deviceLimit: Your organisation's licence has no free device: this account cannot be opened on a new device. Sign out on a device you no longer use, or ask the owner for more devices.
login.accountDeleted: Your account and your personal data were deleted.

acceptInvitation.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvitation.subtitle: Enter the email and verification code your administrator gave you, and choose your password.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to reset your password.
forgotPassword.genericError: Unable to request a password reset.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for this email, a password reset code has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the email, the code we sent you, and your new password.

trial.dataKept: The organisation is now read-only: everyone can still see everything, and all your data is kept - nothing has been deleted. It works as before as soon as the license is activated.
trial.activateError: This activation code could not be used.
trial.askOwner: Ask your organisation owner to enter an activation code or renew the license.
trial.contactIntro: To get an activation code or renew the license (license {{license}}), contact us:
trial.stillEnded: The license has not been renewed yet.
trial.licenseEndedTitle: Your PROSM Time licence has ended
trial.licenseEndedSubtitle: The licence of {{organization}} ended on {{date}}, or was suspended.
trial.contactIntroNoNumber: To renew the licence, contact us:
